# Export Instagram Comments and Posts

The Apify actor [`apify/export-instagram-comments-posts`](https://apify.com/apify/export-instagram-comments-posts) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.63**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape Instagram posts and their comments in one run. Add a username and get post details: caption, likes, tagged users, timestamp, and comment details: text, usernames, profile pics, and likes. Export scraped data, schedule via API, and integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Free — you pay only for the Apify platform usage (compute units) of the run.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/export-instagram-comments-posts) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-export-instagram-comments-posts@0.0.63#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      username: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | array | yes |  | Instagram username(s) — The usernames of the Instagram accounts. |
| `resultsLimitPosts` | integer |  |  | Max posts per username ($2.3 per 1000 posts) — The maximum number of posts to scrape. |
| `resultsLimitComments` | integer |  |  | Max comments per post ($2.3 per 1000 comments) — The maximum number of comments to scrape (per post) |

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `commentText` | string \| null | Text content of the comment |
| `commentTimestamp` | string \| null | ISO 8601 timestamp of when the comment was posted |
| `commentatorUserName` | string \| null | Username of the account that posted the comment |
| `commentatorProfilePicUrl` | string \| null | URL of the commenter's profile picture |
| `postInfo` | object \| null | Details of the post a comment belongs to. Mirrors the post scraper output the actor passes through. |
